newsitem.title: USA: US Treasury's 52-week bill seen at 5.34 percent.
newsitem.headline: US Treasury's 52-week bill seen at 5.34 percent.

text.p: The U.S. Treasury's sale of $19.25 billion in 52-week bills is expected to produce a yield of 5.34 percent, dealers said on Thursday.
"I think it can get out to 5.34 percent," said a bill trader at a primary dealer in New York. "I think the levels are okay and it should go all right there."
In when-issued trading before the 1300 EDT/1700 GMT bidding deadline, year bills were trading at 5.3325 percent.
